change_summary: The registry data flag this paper as retracted, but no retraction notice was found. No current copy was available to show a retraction banner or watermark. The flag is unconfirmed, and it is unknown which parts or findings would be affected or why.
evaluation: Your Methods section measures nitrate with the Novak and Silva sensor and uses their calibration protocol unchanged, so the whole measurement method depends on this paper. The only change is an unconfirmed retraction flag with no notice, and it does not say which parts of the paper would be affected. I count the Methods use as possibly affected, which is uncertain. If the retraction is real, it could matter a lot, because your data collection rests on the sensor.
recommendation: Pause and discuss with your co-authors or supervisor, because your Methods use the Novak and Silva sensor and calibration unchanged and the paper has been flagged as retracted. The flag is unconfirmed, as no notice exists, so first verify it with the journal.
